name: prompt-preflight
description: Feedback on coding-agent prompts before you send them: missing goals, context and success criteria.

promptPreflight.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI.

promptPreflight.provider.description: Model provider for preflight checks. Codex is not implemented yet; use claude.

promptPreflight.model.description: Fallback model used when the quick or deep model override is empty.

promptPreflight.thinkingEffort.description: Provider-native thinking effort passed to the inference request. Claude Code accepts low, medium, high, xhigh, or max.

promptPreflight.quickModel.description: Model for the quick check when you pause typing. Empty falls back to promptPreflight.model, then haiku.

promptPreflight.deepModel.description: Model for detailed feedback. Empty falls back to promptPreflight.model, then sonnet.

promptPreflight.quickReviewOnPause.description: Run the quick model check when you stop typing. Uses your Claude account.

promptPreflight.pauseMs.description: Milliseconds without typing before the quick check runs.

enumDescriptions: Start Claude Code in a new terminal with the prompt.
Copy the prompt, e.g. to paste into the Claude Code chat panel.

promptPreflight.studyLog.enabled.description: Log prompts, scores, timings and Preflight token use to a local file for the user study.

promptPreflight.studyLog.participantId.description: Participant ID written to the study log.

promptPreflight.context.includeCode.description: Which code may be sent to the model provider after secret redaction. Your draft and Q&A answers are always sent.
enumDescriptions: No workspace code, diagnostics or session code is sent.
Only files referenced with @ in the draft are sent.
Every non-excluded workspace file may be sent.
